ways.label: Track to summit and return

start.name: Te Waipapa/Diamond Harbour wharf
start.quote: The track starts from the Te Waipapa/Diamond Harbour wharf.

end.name: Mount Herbert/Te Ahu Pātiki summit
end.quote: The Mount Herbert/Te Ahu Pātiki summit at 920 m

via.name: road up to the Village
via.quote: From the wharf follow the road up towards the Village.

via.name: beach
via.quote: soon dropping down to the beach

via.name: creek bed
via.quote: following a creek bed through pine forest and regenerating bush

via.name: Marine Drive
via.quote: After crossing Marine Drive at a bend

evidence: The track starts from the Te Waipapa/Diamond Harbour wharf.
Either return the same way you came, or continue left on to the Port Levy Saddle and from there to the Rod Donald Hut in 3 hr 20 min.

access_points.name: Bayview Road
access_points.quote: Cross the unsealed Bayview Road and veer slightly left to pick up the track again. This is last place within Diamond Harbour you could start the track, cutting about 30 minutes off your walking time.

access_points.name: Lyttelton ferry to the wharf
access_points.quote: Alternatively take the ferry across the harbour from Lyttelton to the wharf.

doubts: The Diamond Harbour wharf has no clear feature or name entry (coast and place entries exist for Diamond Harbour but not the wharf), so the start ref is null. Marine Drive and Bayview Road are crossed, not followed; no ref given (F3 and F1 are road ends of tracks and may not be these crossing points); F1 is used for the Bayview Road access point because the text says that is where the track can be started. Continuing to Rod Donald Hut or exiting right are described as alternatives at the summit, so the exits are given from the summit.
